episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her insights on using YouTube as a powerful lead generation tool, having closed over $150 million without paid ads. She discusses the importance of a structured lead conversion system, including Zoom consultations and exploratory trips, to filter serious buyers. Additionally, she introduces the showing agent model as a solution for managing multiple clients effectively.
